test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the name of the world's first Gamified Sanskrit learning application, launched by the Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR), along with Gamapp Sportswizz Tech Private Limited in April 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Little Guru.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sanskrit learning** assembles easily with the world's greatest gamified Sanskrit learning App.
 
• The app developed by Gamapp Sportswizz Tech and encouraged by The Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR) has been named** Little Guru.**
 
• It teaches Sanskrit on a communal platform. 
 
• It will help people to understand Sanskrit in a good manner based on competition, games, peer-to-peer communications, etc.
 
• It will also help a number of students and faculties related with **Sanskrit Universities situated all over the world.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
The application is of considerable help to the** Indian Diaspora wishing to stay attached to their roots.**** **

 
 
• The ICCR has provided scholarships to an additional three hundred Chinese students. The motive of these scholarships is to** promote between cultural, cognitive, and academic exchanges India and China.**
 
• The app was established through the celebrations of the** 71st Foundation Day of ICCR​**
